topic: Overwhelming opening Scourge and harsher early runs
currentUserGoal: Make the Scourge dramatically more powerful because the opening experience and early HP drain still felt too gentle.
workCompleted: Raised the Run 1 Scourge base from 100,000 to 10,000,000 Care per second.
Made the first manual touch wake the Scourge with an immediate strike that leaves Ancient HP at 1 before the first production tick.
Kept the first killing production tick at 250 ms, where demand now reaches approximately 63.35 million Care per second.
Rebuilt early-run Scourge scaling around helper kinds actually owned in the current run instead of trusting every permanently unlocked helper.
Closed the debug-unlock loophole where unlocking the full Memory web could make a nearly unequipped field receive mature-game Scourge pacing.
Shortened the deterministic first Tiny Sprinkler attempt from several minutes to approximately 40 seconds.
Preserved the separate mature ecosystem curve so a fully developed 100x100 field can still reach a sustained thriving state.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 144 Vitest tests across 19 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
A fresh browser run showed Ancient HP at 1/100 and Scourge at 10,000,000 Care/s immediately after the first touch.
The fresh browser run reached Game Over on the first 250 ms production tick at approximately 63,354,200 Care/s and still awarded 7 GT.
The deterministic first Tiny Sprinkler run now lasts 40.25 seconds under the standard manual-touch fixture.
An early run with every Memory debug-unlocked but only one actual sprinkler still receives the harsh first-capability Scourge tier.
No browser warnings, console errors, or page errors were observed.

release.status: Verified local Scourge checkpoint; not merged into master or promoted to production.

currentGitStatus: The branch contains two earlier local commits ahead of origin before this Scourge checkpoint.
docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains an unrelated untracked file and must stay untouched unless the user explicitly requests it.
The local Vite server remains available at http://127.0.0.1:5173.
knownIssues: Run 1 is now an intentionally authored collapse rather than a survivable challenge.
The first Tiny Sprinkler run is intentionally much shorter than the earlier three-to-five-minute target and should be judged hands-on.
The semantic DOM readout refreshes on its normal interval, so the 1 HP opening strike is clearest in the rendered HUD before Game Over.
nextRecommendedSteps: Hands-on test a reset Run 1 and the complete first Memory to Run 2 transition.
Tune the 40-second first automation attempt only after the stronger pressure has been felt directly.
Add stronger Scourge strike visual and audio presentation if the mechanics now feel right but the impact still lacks spectacle.
doNotRevert: Do not let permanent helper unlock count alone grant gentler Scourge pacing.
Keep Run 1 manual healing disabled and the guaranteed 7 GT first-collapse reward.
Do not restore the previous multi-minute first Tiny Sprinkler test band without explicit playtest feedback.
Do not use the legacy 1,200-tile harness as evidence for ecosystemPrototype performance.
